text:
Maya C (CSM): quick heads-up — Stalwart Labs beta enrollment stalled. they didn’t complete the setup survey and we missed the enablement call window. they’re requesting a short remediation session next week. ;(

Evan L (Onboarding): re: remediation — i can run a 30m walk-through. Wed 10am or Thu 2pm PT?

Maya C (CSM): Thu 2pm PT works for them. can you take the session + record it? we need a short clip to share with other pilot seats. @Alex R can you prep the integration checklist?

Alex R (Solutions): yep i’ll prep a lean checklist and a short snippet to drop into the recording. also will bring the quick-start token steps — some teams hit the quota edge when they start streaming.

Jules P (PM): ping — quick ask: can we capture the missing survey answers before the session? that feedback feeds our early product evaluation and renewal signals. i can make a 3-question form.

Maya C (CSM): good call. @Integrations Bot can you DM the survey link to the Stalwart admin and post it in the pilot channel if they don’t reply in 24h?

Integrations Bot: scheduled msg: will DM Stalwart admin with survey link and post reminder in #pilot-stalwart in 24 hours if no response.

Evan L (Onboarding): survey draft? small so we get quick responses. propose: 1) primary use-case, 2) rollout blockers, 3) critical metrics to evaluate success.

Jules P (PM): perfect — here’s the public short form: https://shortforms.example.com/stalwart-beta (3 q’s) — please use that link in the DM.

Priya S (AE): flagging a renewal risk: Stalwart’s procurement team mentioned data residency concerns in last call. if enablement slips again, they may drop to a 6mo renewal. i’ll join the Thu session to own the escalation.

Maya C (CSM): thanks Priya — noted. action items: Evan run Thu 2pm PT (record), Alex supply checklist & token guidance, Jules publish form and add to DM, Priya join to manage procurement concern. I’ll follow up with a 1-pager for execs summarizing risks.

Alex R (Solutions): adding a quick snippet to share during the call: `run --init --set-token <token>` and a short troubleshooting note for quota bump requests.

Evan L (Onboarding): calendar invite sent to group + Stalwart admin, recording enabled, draft agenda: 1) quick setup verification (10m) 2) hands-on walkthrough (15m) 3) Q&A + next steps (5m).

Maya C (CSM): perfect — thanks team. i’ll post a short recap + the recording link after the call and tag the AE for the renewal update. :thumbsup:

Priya S (AE): appreciate it. if procurement asks for a timeline for private deployment, i’ll escalate to infra. keep me looped.

Maya C (CSM): will do.
